pdm_repossession.compatibility: Old missing DefaultPercent remains zero; regular finance API retained. New risk-enabled native sales only. Existing Pdm/Finance/Logistics/Staff/Safe JSON defaults unchanged. No personal Transport conversion.

pdm_repossession.scope_limits: Normal parked-car variant only; driving borrowers, combat encounters, negotiable collections, precise ramp/winch physics, rental and other PDM systems remain subsequent work/refinement. Phases 8/9 retained.

pdm_rental_supply.wallet_checkpoint: Pdm.Rental with exact stock IDs/cargo/rig handles, price snapshots and Delivered/Returned. Before acceptance cancel unlocks paid stock; after acceptance preserve payable order, normal payout after returned checkpoint.
pdm_rental_supply.recovery: Authenticate exact rig/cargo. pdm_rental_supply.compatibility: Absent Rental means no order. Existing Pdm/Finance/Repo/Logistics/Staff/Safe configs and personal Transport unchanged; only new config installed if absent.
pdm_rental_supply.intentional_differences: Own catalogue models/rate, always-available offers conditional on two matching paid ready stock instead of random legacy daily queue. No screen fades, disabled player controls, occupied cargo attachment, invincibility or global cleanup. Not consumer vehicle rental.
pdm_rental_supply.scope_limits: One two-car fleet supply contract at a time; no consumer rental/deposit/return cycle, random daily order queue, custom dialogue/audio, detailed ramp physics or full remaining PDM parity. Phases 8/9 retained.

pdm_showroom.scope_limits: No preview cameras, cover-cloth system, automatic reputation/random sales, forced interior access or full building/staff upgrades. Interior/floor readiness and occupied bays can leave display pending; phases 8/9 retained.

RPCore 6.3A limits mutable fields to safely captured component 2 and valid freemode eye color, supports available protagonist hair variations, normal camera/rotation and own configurable 150 bank fee.
barber.scope_limits: 6.3B adds confirmation-only tint/beard/brows; 6.3C extends the same service with skin/makeup overlays. 6.3D adds optional heritage and 20 facial morphs. 6.3E adds explicit freemode creation/loading in isolated slots. No tattoo library or dedicated camera. Native appearance/texture/cancellation and coexistence with vanilla barbers need GTA testing. Phases 8/9 retained.

grooming.rpcore_cycle: Freemode/ready-head-blend only, optional independent hair-tint/beard/brows groups, no character preview during selection, correct palette RGB swatches, explicit paid confirmation, durable pending/started/completed checkpoints and free resume/reapply.
grooming.wallet_checkpoint: Additive Wallet.Grooming. Begin reserves bank fee/pending; Start is durably saved before any appearance setter; Complete merges selected groups and clears pending with no extra debit. grooming.compatibility: Does not read RGB palette function as current ped tint. No memory offsets, forced default head blend, ped replacement, clothing or auto-load. Preserves unknown record fields and unselected live groups. Existing Barber.json and cuts/eyes service untouched.
grooming.intentional_differences: Reference live-preview overwrites character appearance fields. Exact previously recorded selected values are free to reapply.
grooming.scope_limits: 6.3C adds skin/makeup overlays; 6.3D adds optional heritage and 20 facial morphs. 6.3E adds explicit freemode creation/loading in isolated slots; no tattoos or automatic startup appearance. Rendering/silent native setters cannot be verified in this cloud. Paid-started failure remains recoverable; never claims to refund and undo unknown colors. Phases 8/9 retained.

cosmetics.runtime_preflight: Freemode/ready blend, native per-overlay style count and palette count; cosmetics use makeup RGB getter instead of hair RGB. No default face, new model or guessed current opacity/color.
cosmetics.wallet_checkpoint: Existing single configurable 120 bank fee for any combination, no additional per-overlay charge. Durable begin/start/complete, free resume/reapply, unstarted refund only; old 0.35 paid orders remain readable.

cosmetics.scope_limits: Freemode must already exist. Heritage and facial morph controls added in 6.3D. 6.3E adds explicit profile/model loading; no tattoos or dedicated camera. Body overlays can be hidden by clothes. No complete native opacity/color readback; rendered result needs GTA testing. Phases 8/9 retained.

After durable Start, SET_PED_HEAD_BLEND_DATA with third contribution zero, then tick-driven HAS_PED_HEAD_BLEND_FINISHED wait (at least next tick, max 10s), selected morph setters and surface overlays, then durable Complete. Keeps ShiftGate lease until finish/interruption, without blocking/freeze/camera.
face_editor.compatibility: Old look/pending deserialization adds empty Morphs and null Heritage without setters or migration; preserves previous cosmetics, unknown fields, profiles and configuration. No face capture by guessed offsets. No model or profile switching. Interrupted started order stays paid and resumable.

Independent shape/skin origin pairs, signed native morph range and native parent catalog replace reference fixed 0..45 sliders and 0..1 morph clamp.
face_editor.scope_limits: 6.3E adds explicit freemode creation/loading. No live reversible preview, full current morph readback, third-parent contribution, tattoo library or dedicated camera. Heritage explicitly replaces the base face/skin blend; resulting native detail composition needs GTA testing. Full creator parity/refinement and phases 8/9 remain pending.

characters.intentional_differences: Reference creator previews/replaces ped while selecting and initializes starting money/gang/location. RPCore separates profile creation from confirmed loading, uses current position, zero balances and protected equipment snapshots; no automatic load or forced gang/property/vehicle changes.
characters.scope_limits: No complete external ped/face/stat/movement-state capture, protagonist mission task restoration, creation camera, arbitrary add-on ped catalog, default gang/start-money choices or automatic PSRP appearance import. Model/weapon restoration and story scripts must be tested in GTA. Phases 8/9 retained.
